PREFIX eno: <http://example.org/ontology/energy#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?deposit ?depositName (SUM(?extractedCrude) AS ?totalExtractedCrude)
WHERE {
  ?deposit a eno:Deposit .
  OPTIONAL { ?deposit eno:designation ?depositName . }
  ?output eno:outputForDeposit ?deposit .
  ?output eno:extractedCrude ?extractedCrude .
}
GROUP BY ?deposit ?depositName
HAVING (SUM(?extractedCrude) > 50000000)
ORDER BY DESC(?totalExtractedCrude)

deepseek_base/BASE03_agentic_grep_74c4f8.final_sparql:
PREFIX oriont: <https://orienting.eu/oriont#>
PREFIX oriont-ext: <https://orienting.eu/oriont-ext#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?activity ?activityLabel ?flow ?flowLabel ?flowDirection
WHERE {
  ?activity a oriont:Activity .
  ?activity rdfs:label ?activityLabel .
  
  {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isInputOf ?activity .
    ?flow rdfs:label ?flowLabel .
    BIND("Input" AS ?flowDirection)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isOutputOf ?activity .
    ?flow rdfs:label ?flowLabel .
    BIND("Output" AS ?flowDirection)
  }
}
ORDER BY ?activityLabel ?flowDirection

}

PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?lineAbbreviation 
       (COUNT(?stopEvent) AS ?totalStopEvents) 
       (AVG(?stopEventsPerTrip) AS ?avgStopEventsPerJourney)
WHERE {

  ?line a tro:Line .
  ?line tro:abbreviation ?lineAbbreviation .
  
  # Get trips for this line
  ?trip a tro:Trip .
  ?trip tro:line ?line .
  
  # Get stop events for this trip
  ?stopEvent a tro:StopEvent .
  ?stopEvent tro:journey ?trip .
  
  # Count stop events per trip (for average calculation)
  {
    SELECT ?trip (COUNT(?se) AS ?stopEventsPerTrip)
    WHERE {
      ?se a tro:StopEvent .
      ?se tro:journey ?trip .
    }
    GROUP BY ?trip
  }
}
GROUP BY ?lineAbbreviation
ORDER BY ?lineAbbreviation

PREFIX bsbm: <http://www4.wiwiss.fu-berlin.de/bizer/bsbm/v01/vocabulary/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?basicModuleLabel ?advancedModuleLabel ?instructorLabel ?divisionLabel

  ?tutor a eduo:Tutor .
  ?tutor eduo:label ?instructorLabel .

  ?basicModule eduo:label ?basicModuleLabel .

deepseek_base/BASE12_agentic_semantic_12.query_text: List all basic modules and advanced modules with their instructors and division.
deepseek_base/BASE12_agentic_semantic_12.final_sparql:
PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?basicModuleLabel ?advancedModuleLabel ?instructor ?divisionLabel WHERE {
  # Basic modules with their tutors (instructors)
  ?doctoralCandidate a eduo:DoctoralCandidate .
  ?doctoralCandidate eduo:tutorOf ?basicModule .
  ?basicModule eduo:label ?basicModuleLabel .
  
  # Get the instructor (tutor) - DoctoralCandidate is the tutor
  BIND(?doctoralCandidate AS ?instructor)
  
  # Get advanced modules the tutor is enrolled in
  ?doctoralCandidate eduo:enrolledIn ?advancedModule .
  
  # Get division information via Tutor class
  ?tutor a eduo:Tutor .
  ?tutor eduo:belongsTo ?division .
  ?division eduo:label ?divisionLabel .
  
  # Connect tutor to doctoral candidate (they are the same entity)
  FILTER(?tutor = ?doctoralCandidate)
}

  ?exchange oriont-ext:hasFlowName ?flowName .
  ?exchange oriont-ext:hasMeasureValue ?measureValue .
  ?exchange oriont-ext:hasMeasureUnit ?measureUnit .
}
ORDER BY ?process ?exchange

deepseek_syn/SYN06_agentic_grep_dd41a75e.final_sparql:
PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?route (COUNT(?stopEvent) AS ?totalHalts) (AVG(?tripStopCount) AS ?meanHaltsPerTrip) WHERE {
  # First count stops per trip
  {
    SELECT ?trip (COUNT(?stopEvent) AS ?tripStopCount) WHERE {
      ?trip rdf:type tro:Trip .
      ?stopEvent rdf:type tro:StopEvent .
      
      # Try reverse connection - maybe StopEvent has property pointing to Trip
      ?stopEvent ?p ?trip .
      
      # Get stop sequence to ensure it's a valid stop event
      ?stopEvent tro:stopSequence ?sequence .
    }
    GROUP BY ?trip
  }
  
  # Get route for each trip
  ?trip tro:line ?route .
}
GROUP BY ?route
ORDER BY ?route
LIMIT 5

deepseek_syn/SYN08_agentic_grep_28e9a0f7.final_sparql:
PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT ?place ?placeName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?trip) AS ?tripCount)

  ?stopEvent a tro:StopEvent .

  ?stopEvent tro:station ?stop .
  ?stop foaf:name ?placeName .
  ?stop dcterms:identifier ?place .
}
GROUP BY ?place ?placeName
ORDER BY DESC(?tripCount)
LIMIT 10

deepseek_syn/SYN09_agentic_semantic_5d6d.final_sparql:
PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX ub: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?faculty ?facultyLabel WHERE {
  # Find faculty who teach courses
  ?faculty a eduo:Faculty .
  ?faculty eduo:label ?facultyLabel .
  
  # Find courses taught by this faculty
  ?faculty eduo:instructorOf ?course .
  
  # Ensure the course is an AdvancedModule (upper-level class)
  ?course a ub:AdvancedModule .
  
  # Check if faculty has no supervision relationships
  # Using a simpler approach: check if faculty is NOT a Tutor
  # Since mentor relationships are only defined on Tutor class
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?faculty a eduo:Tutor .
  }
}
ORDER BY ?facultyLabel

deepseek_syn/SYN11_agentic_grep_0bae8f8b.final_sparql:
PREFIX eno: <http://example.org/ontology/energy#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?deposit ?designation (SUM(?producedOilEquivalents) AS ?totalOil)
WHERE {
  ?production a eno:DepositMonthlyProduction .
  ?production eno:outputForDeposit ?deposit .
  ?production eno:producedOilEquivalents ?producedOilEquivalents .
  ?deposit eno:designation ?designation .
}
GROUP BY ?deposit ?designation
HAVING (SUM(?producedOilEquivalents) > -1)

deepseek_typo/TYPO03_agentic_grep_f29475.final_sparql:
PREFIX oriont: <https://orienting.eu/oriont#>
PREFIX oriont-ext: <https://orienting.eu/oriont-ext#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?activity ?activityLabel ?flow ?flowName ?flowUnit ?flowValue ?flowDirection
WHERE {
  ?activity a oriont:Activity .
  ?activity rdfs:label ?activityLabel .
  
  {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isOutputOf ?activity .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasFlowName ?flowName .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasMeasureUnit ?flowUnit .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasMeasureValue ?flowValue .
    BIND("input" AS ?flowDirection)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isInputOf ?activity .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasFlowName ?flowName .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasMeasureUnit ?flowUnit .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasMeasureValue ?flowValue .
    BIND("output" AS ?flowDirection)
  }
}
ORDER BY ?activity ?flowDirection

deepseek_typo/TYPO03_agentic_grep_f72393.query_text: List activites with thier input and outptu flows.
deepseek_typo/TYPO03_agentic_grep_f72393.final_sparql:
PREFIX oriont: <https://orienting.eu/oriont#>
PREFIX oriont-ext: <https://orienting.eu/oriont-ext#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?activity ?activityLabel ?flow ?flowName ?flowValue ?flowUnit ?flowDirection
WHERE {
  ?activity a oriont:Activity .
  ?activity rdfs:label ?activityLabel .
  
  {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isInputOf ?activity .
    BIND("Input" AS ?flowDirection)
  } UNION {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isOutputOf ?activity .
    BIND("Output" AS ?flowDirection)
  }
  
  ?flow oriont-ext:hasFlowName ?flowName .
  ?flow oriont-ext:hasMeasureValue ?flowValue .
  ?flow oriont-ext:hasMeasureUnit ?flowUnit .
}
ORDER BY ?activity ?flowDirection ?flow

deepseek_typo/TYPO03_agentic_semantic_b0.final_sparql:
PREFIX oriont: <https://orienting.eu/oriont#>
PREFIX oriont-ext: <https://orienting.eu/oriont-ext#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?activity ?activityLabel ?flow ?flowName ?flowDirection
WHERE {
  ?activity a oriont:Activity .
  ?activity rdfs:label ?activityLabel .
  
  {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isOutputOf ?activity .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasFlowName ?flowName .
    BIND("input" AS ?flowDirection)
  } UNION {
    ?flow a oriont:Flow .
    ?flow oriont:isInputOf ?activity .
    ?flow oriont-ext:hasFlowName ?flowName .
    BIND("output" AS ?flowDirection)
  }
}
ORDER BY ?activityLabel ?flowDirection ?flowName
LIMIT 50

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?module ?moduleLabel ?moduleType ?instructor ?division ?divisionLabel
WHERE {
  {
    # Basic modules with their tutors and divisions
    ?module a eduo:BasicModule .
    ?module eduo:label ?moduleLabel .
    ?tutor eduo:tutorOf ?module .
    ?tutor a eduo:Tutor .

    OPTIONAL { ?product rdfs:label ?label }
}
ORDER BY ?price
